title: Bound completed output refresh proof
summary: Bound the Completed Output current-status refresh to recent bounded proof and skip expensive final-library promotion filesystem probes while promotion is disabled.
reason: The active completed manifest recorded the latest jobs, but the WebView current-output refresh requested full live proof for the entire completed history and also evaluated disabled promotion rows against UNC paths, causing the route to exceed the UI timeout.
behavior_before: Refresh Current Output Status requested limit=all with live proof and final-library promotion status loaded completed rows with live output proof even when promotion was disabled.
behavior_after: Refresh Current Output Status requests the recent 500 completed rows with bounded proof, and disabled promotion status uses summary completed proof without per-row output existence checks.
manual_validation: active-state service check against E:/Videos/Scratch - completed bounded 500 rows in 5.607s, first row Witch Hat Atelier - S01E13.mkv; disabled promotion status in 1.588s

apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest discover -s tests/python/desktop -p test_completed_proof_budget.py -q - blocked by pre-existing circular import through mediapipeline.core.publish.reconciliation_policy
change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed due unrelated uncovered dependency-atlas/generated-summary files outside this packet
rollback_plan: Revert the WebView refresh URL and the final-library promotion proof-mode/output-probe changes, then rerun the targeted completed and final-library promotion tests.
notes:
Avoid output and sidecar filesystem proof while final-library promotion is disabled.
Use bounded recent completed proof for Refresh Current Output Status instead of full live proof.
Cover disabled promotion proof behavior and summary-proof service loading.
Update static WebView contract for bounded current-output completed refresh.
Load final-library promotion status with summary completed proof when promotion is disabled.
